entities.name: Lyese
entities.description: Elven sister of Glissa, who survived the Levelers, was made a minion of Memnarch, and became khana of the leonin.

entities.name: Memnarch
entities.description: Corrupted god whose minions Glissa fought.

entities.name: Vektro
entities.description: Body-possessing being who ambushed Lyese and made her Memnarch's minion.

entities.name: Raksha Golden Cub
entities.description: Leonin kha of Taj Nar, overthrown by Lyese.

entities.name: Yshkar
entities.description: Cousin of Raksha whom Lyese married and later killed.

entities.name: Jilad
entities.description: Location on Lyese's home plane where the Vanishing brought her.

entities.name: Oxidda Chain
entities.description: Mountains where Glissa's goblin allies were.

events.summary: After the Fifth Dawn it is revealed Lyese survived the Levelers, scarred and missing an eye, and blames Glissa.
events.quote: it was revealed that she survived, although scarred and having lost an eye

events.summary: Lyese reconciles with Glissa while aiding her against Memnarch's minions.
On her way to the Oxidda Chain, Lyese is ambushed by Vektro and made a minion of Memnarch.
events.quote: Lyese was ambushed and made a minion of Memnarch by the body-possessing Vektro

events.summary: Lyese ousts Raksha, marries and kills Yshkar, and becomes khana as the leonin's acting leader.
events.quote: she married and later killed his cousin Yshkar

events.summary: Vektro abandons Lyese's body after she is mortally wounded in the final battle in Kuldotha, and Glissa heals her.
events.quote: before being healed by her sister

events.summary: After Mirrodin is restored, the Vanishing brings Lyese to Jilad on her home plane.
events.quote: the Vanishing brought Lyese to a location called Jilad

relations.note: Possessed her and made her Memnarch's minion.
relations.quote: made a minion of Memnarch by the body-possessing Vektro
she married and later killed his cousin Yshkar

relations.note: Became his minion under Vektro's control.
